d:
Samajwadi Party leader Azam Khan is once again in the spotlight over the alleged money laundering case linked to Mohammad Ali Jauhar University. After spending nearly 11 months in jail, he was granted bail on October 31, but the Enforcement Directorate arrested him soon after his release. A special PMLA court has now granted the ED four days of custody to question him about the university’s land, construction and financial transactions. What are the allegations against Azam Khan, and how did the Jauhar University case unfold?
